$schema_note: PRAXIS Block-2 backtest cost + instrument model. Single source of truth consumed by BOTH the NT8 Strategy Analyzer (VM) backtest config and the Python (Mac) Monte Carlo layer. Encodes trader-locked decision D-2026-07-15-B (Q5). Do NOT hand-edit numbers without a corresponding DECISIONS.md entry.

cost_model.commission_note: Applied once per completed round-turn (entry+exit) per contract. If the backtest engine expresses commission per-side, use 1.48 USD/side.
cost_model.fill_resolution_note: NT8 Strategy Analyzer 'Order fill resolution' = High (intrabar sub-bar granularity for stop/target/entry fills; reduces optimistic same-bar fill artifacts). Python MC assumes fills already reflect this via the exported NT8 trade list.
cost_model.total_cost_breakdown_note: 12.96 = 2.96 commission + 10.00 slippage (2 ticks x 5.00). In ticks: 0.592 commission-equivalent + 2.0 slippage = 2.592 ticks round-turn.

applies_to: All P&L distributions (NT8 WFA fills + Python Monte Carlo)
All Strategy Health Monitor (SHM) distributions and threshold derivations (D-2026-07-04-B)
R-multiple conversion: costs deducted before R normalization (Q6)
